environment.description: Terraform provider executing on a Fargate task within a VPC private subnet (subnet-0x7f3a2e). The subnet route table (rtb-04d8c1a9) contains only local routes (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for S3, and no transit gateway attachment. Security group (sg-0a3b7c9d2e) has egress rules limited to port 443 toward the internal Terraform Enterprise endpoint (10.0.12.50/32) only. The task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoExternalNetworkBoundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface for any subnet with a route to 0.0.0.0/0. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero bytes transmitted to any non-RFC1918 destination in the past 90 days.
